findings.evidence: CompletedReceipts is scanned without cardinality or element-shape admission, then deserialized before ValidateSize. The reviewed owning probe accepts a 300071-byte H=10000 row with 100000 empty receipt objects; its retained typed graph is 5848792 bytes versus 4S=3789824, and owning sizing dereferences the missing MessageId. This is a separate unbounded collection from R3-E2 digest storage and a retained-memory result, not only cumulative allocations.

Resolve fallback by actual route while preserving complete admission, coordinated identities and stable recovery.

The process pass owns an await-using scope containing catalog and runner. Catalog reads use WithReadDeadline/ProcessReadDeadline and runner translator/provider operations use that same abandonment helper; timeout/cancellation can return while scoped work continues, then RunPass disposes the scope. This is the distinct process caller lifetime boundary in external 0b38 recovery work, separate from D6 reminder scope ownership.

Partial non-replay sibling completion removes completed routes from pending but merges every reservation token into the replacement work. Scheduler ValidateWorkItem explicitly rejects a token whose route is not pending before any mutation. Thus a real interrupted sibling completion cannot persist its intended retry update. Filter merged tokens to the exact remaining pending inventory; included in higher cascade.

The decorator resolves concrete QueryRouter from TryAddScoped<QueryRouter>(), so DI chooses its public two-argument constructor and never supplies _sourceGuard. The guarded IQueryRouter factory is overridden. Persisted Idle/metadata can therefore report Current after source growth or guard invalidity. Preserve one guarded owning construction path through actual decorated production registration and test the composed route.
